questions.query: I consent to participate in this child survey
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Child Survey

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study

Purpose: We are conducting research to understand how children perceive their educational experiences. This survey will collect information about your school experiences and preferences.

What you will do: Answer questions about your school life and activities. This should take approximately 5-10 minutes.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept confidential and used only for research purposes.

Voluntary Participation: Your participation is completely voluntary. You may stop at any time without penalty.
Hello {childName}! We would like to learn about your experiences at {school}. Please answer the following questions honestly. There are no right or wrong answers.

questions.query: What is your favorite subject at school?
How much do you enjoy going to school?
questions.prefix: Rate your enjoyment (1 = Not at all, 5 = Very much)

questions.query: Which activities do you enjoy doing? (Select all that apply)
About how many hours do you spend on homework each week?
Rate how hard you try at the following (1 = Not hard at all, 5 = Very hard):
What do you want to be when you grow up?

questions.text: Thank you {childName} for sharing your thoughts with us! Your answers will help us better understand how to support students at {school}.
